resources.string:
The guard sees which app is open. If it is an app your parent has not allowed, or its time is up, the guard closes it and shows why.

To keep Plainphone switched on, the guard also reads the text on some Android settings pages. That text stays on this phone.

Your parent can see which apps are on the phone and how many minutes you used apps that have a time limit.
Without the guard, Plainphone cannot close apps your parent has not allowed. Setup waits here until you are ready.

Plainphone collects location data to enable Find, “Are you okay?” and the SOS button even when the app is closed or not in use.\n\nEach time your parent asks where the phone is, you see a notice. Only the latest position is kept.
Your parents’ rules apply on this phone. Tap to see what they can see.
